title: The best tour to the Alhambra.
text: We did the family tour of the Alhambra with Sumaya; the truth is that you cannot visit this wonderful place without a good guide who explains everything in detail. Sumaya was very detail-oriented, very knowledgeable, and greatly enriched the experience; we recommend Nazarí Tours without a doubt. The tour was private for our family, which made it even better; we are extremely satisfied!

title: Great guided tour of the Alhambra - also exciting for children
text:
We did a guided tour of the Alhambra with Nazari Tours (four adults and children aged 10 to 14 years) and were absolutely thrilled! The organization was excellent – from the uncomplicated booking to the smooth running on site everything worked great ink.l Tips for our belly in Granada.
Sumaya was extremely friendly, competent and managed to convey the exciting history of the Alhambra in a lively way – both for us adults and for the children.
The tour was informative, entertaining and very entertaining. A real highlight of our holiday in Andalusia!
We can recommend Nazari Tours without restrict

title: With pleasure in history
text:
The Alhambra is a great historical monument to be seen.  Of course, the appropriate historical background also belongs to this monument. Our guide, Sumaya, was able to convey this background very well with an impressive knowledge. The 3 hours were very entertaining and we would have liked to have listened to her even further.
All in all, it was great fun and really worth his money.
author: Ralf B
